purpose: Reference content for integration into the current production hub; not an automatically installed patch
name: Ninja
current_game_distribution: Free civilian pool; eligible with legacy saved loadouts
description: Throw a dagger and teleport to it. Hit a player to stun them and appear behind them. Conceal an area in black smoke, bait attacks with a clone, and avoid ground traps.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: Throw your dagger up to 5 units at the marker, then teleport. A player hit stuns them for 3 seconds with circling stars and takes you behind them. Walls block the throw. Aiming does not zoom or show a range circle.

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.description: Drop a hand-sized bomb to make a black cloud about 12 units across for 10 seconds. Everyone inside is protected from kills. The dense smoke obscures the area without reducing normal vision range. Ninjas see highlighted players inside it.

abilities.name: Clone Jutsu
abilities.description: Perform a short summoning jutsu to create one idle copy. Attacking it wastes the killer's cooldown, leaves a log for the round, and alerts you. A completed cast replaces your old clone.

abilities.name: Light Feet
abilities.description: Walk over autograph, mine, chocolate, string, and helmet traps without triggering them.

integration_notes: Use the current production hub source; the local sibling checkout is stale.
